assay: bulk RNA-seq of primary human monocyte-derived macrophages infected ex vivo with C. parapsilosis isolates (GSE344550); fungal RNA-seq in GSE312575
primary_estimand: Macrophage transcriptional response to low-biofilm-producing (LBP: 29T, 49B) versus biofilm-producing (BP: 1T, 35B) C. parapsilosis isolates at 3 h and 24 h post-infection. No exercise, training, or physical-activity factor exists anywhere in the study.
sample_inclusion: macrophages from human donors infected with 4 isolates or uninfected; 30 libraries in GEO
planned_contrasts: BP vs LBP infected macrophages at 3 h (S4.13.p1, S2.7.p1)
BP vs LBP infected macrophages at 24 h (S4.13.p1, S2.7.p1)

paper_threshold.note: paper states only |log2FC| > 1; no p or FDR rule is stated

paper_method: edgeR on raw counts, TMM library normalization, low-expression filtering, ~ 0 + group:time; fgsea preranked on log2FC (S4.13.p1)
paper_results: DEG counts for macrophages are not stated in the text; results reported as GSEA (Fig 5, S4 Fig)
